messages:
Anya R: quick question — during today's canary we saw SM% spikes and a bunch of KV evictions. where's the best dashboard + trace index to pull both together?
Sam T: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/gpuops/overview (panel ids: sm-heatmap = 3, kv-evictions = 12). open panel -> "Explore" to jump into prom queries or traces.
Lee: Tempo link from grafana open -> "Open in traces" should prefill pool tag. or search in tempo: service:"inference-serving" AND pool_id:"pool-7" AND tag.run_type:"canary"
Anya R: any compact PromQL to get per-pool SM% (5m) and a separate one for eviction rate?
Sam T: SM% (5m):
```promql
100 * avg by(pool_id) (rate(gpu_sm_active_cycles_total[5m]) / rate(gpu_sm_total_cycles_total[5m]))
```
Sam T: KV eviction rate (per min):
```promql
sum by(pool_id) (increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m]))
```
Marie C: fwiw the alert "gpu_sm_high" triggered repeatedly for pool-7. I think we should suppress canary jobs for that alert rather than bump the threshold globally.
Lee: agree. suppression by run_type=canary is cleaner. we have label on jobs so alert manager can exclude those.
Anya R: can someone file the alert-manager change? I'll need the PR to review before we merge so the next canary doesn't spam ops.
Sam T: opening PR now — https://git.redwood/infrastructure/alerts/pull/802 (adds canary suppression to gpu_sm_high; adds annotation). note: CI passed, waiting on reviewers.
DeployBot: alert rule change PR 802 merged and deployed to staging.
InfraBot: deployed alert config to prod: version v2026-03-16-802
Anya R: thanks. last ask — any BigQuery snippet to fetch eviction log lines by job/request id? want to join with our job table.
Sam T: use this:
```sql
SELECT ts, pool_id, request_id, severity, text
FROM `redwood-prod.logging.gpu_evictions`
WHERE pool_id = 'pool-7'
AND ts BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 45 MINUTE) AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 500
```
Marie C: leaving a note in the canary runbook and adding grafana annotation for the time window 2026-03-16T14:02:00Z -> 2026-03-16T14:22:00Z
Anya R: perfect. flagging @Sam T for the CR on the PR if anything else pops up :pray:
Sam T: got it, will ping when the PR is ready for final review :+1:
Anya R: closing out, thanks everyone :v:
